description: Taxi is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by GTL-TAXI. Contains information on taxi- and hired cars with drivers in Belgium (companies). Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in XML. The data standards named are datex-II. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other-nc. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
